items.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] The way with no way: when grace has struck firm, one word from the teacher and the immersion is ever-risen — no means required. [1] Four impossibilities: no nature to attain, nothing to notify, no covering to remove, no one to enter; the means itself impossible. [2] All is one consciousness-only reality — unmeasured, unbounded, unfaded, uncontrolled, unindicated, unelaborated — autonomous, bliss-dense; I am that, with the universe mirrored in me. [3] No mantra, worship, meditation, or conduct binds one who sees this steadily.
